title: AntiDeath-Survival-Assistant
description: Client-side survival assistant for Minecraft 1.21.x–26.x. Provides various quality-of-life tools for survival gameplay. Requires MaLiLib.
body:
# AntiDeath Survival Assistant

AntiDeath Survival Assistant is a lightweight client-side utility mod based on MaLiLib, designed to improve the vanilla survival experience with various quality-of-life features and gameplay helpers.

## Features

### Survival Assistance

- Low health warnings
- Automatic command/chat execution
- Creeper danger alerts
- Inventory management utilities
- Shulker box helpers
- Various configurable survival tools

### Visual Tweaks

- Disable rotating dropped items
- Transparent item frames
- Optional visual improvements

## Why Use This Mod?

AntiDeath Survival Assistant provides useful tools for everyday survival gameplay while remaining lightweight and fully configurable.

- Client-side only
- Works on vanilla servers
- Highly configurable through MaLiLib
- Lightweight and easy to use

## Supported Versions

- Minecraft **1.21.x – 26.x**

---

# AntiDeath 生存助手

AntiDeath 生存助手是一款基于 MaLiLib 的轻量级客户端辅助模组，为原版生存模式提供多种实用功能。

## 功能

### 生存辅助

- 低血量提醒
- 自动发送命令或聊天消息
- 苦力怕危险警告
- 背包管理工具
- 潜影盒辅助功能
- 多种可配置的生存工具

### 视觉调整

- 禁用掉落物旋转
- 展示框透明化
- 其他可选视觉优化

## 为什么使用？

AntiDeath 生存助手专注于提升日常生存体验，在保持轻量的同时提供丰富的辅助功能。

- 纯客户端运行
- 可在原版服务器使用
- 基于 MaLiLib 配置系统
- 高度可配置

## 支持版本

- Minecraft **1.21.x – 26.x**
